---
title: "Brain CD45 and HG cells: phagocytosis score and neutrophil genes"
output: html_document
---

Brain CD45+ immune cells and high granularity (HG) cells from PBS- and AEC-treated mice (GEO: GSE301590).

Phagocytosis module score, neutrophil genes and cell cycle scores in myeloid and HG cells.
Starts from `data/scrna/Cd45_HG.rds`, saved by `02_merge_CD45_HG.Rmd`.

```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE)
```

# Load the packages
```{r Load the Packages}
library(Seurat)
library(cowplot)
library(patchwork)
library(Matrix)
library(tidyverse)
library(RColorBrewer)

for (d in c("data/scrna", "results/Brain_Cd45_HG/Targeted_genes", "results/Brain_Cd45_HG/Trajectory", "results/Brain_Cd45_HG/NicheNet", "results/Brain_Cd45_HG/tradeseq_input")) {
  dir.create(d, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)
}
```

pdf(file = "results/Brain_Cd45_HG/phago_subtypes.pdf", width = 12, height =6)
VlnPlot(DATA, features = "Phagocytosis.Score1", group.by = "Subtypes2")

pdf(file = "results/Brain_Cd45_HG/phago_subtypes_nodot.pdf", width = 12, height =6)

# Neutrophil genes and proliferation
```{r }
DATA <- readRDS("data/scrna/Cd45_HG.rds")
DATA2 <- SetIdent(DATA, value = "Celltypes") %>% subset(idents = c( "High Granularity Cells", "Neutrophil", "Monocytes", "Macrophages")) %>%  NormalizeData()

neutrophil_genes <- c("Ly6g", "Gsr","Csf1r", "Adgre1", "Cx3cr1", "Fpr2", "Cmklr1", "Gpr18","Ifitm6","Retnlg", "Ccr2","Cd14", "Ly6c1","Ly6c2")
pdf(file = "results/Brain_Cd45_HG/Neutrophil_Genes.pdf", width = 8, height =6)
VlnPlot(DATA2, features = neutrophil_genes,group.by = "Subtypes", stack = T, flip = T)
dev.off()
DotPlot(DATA2, features = neutrophil_genes,group.by = "Subtypes")+coord_flip()

pdf(file = "results/Brain_Cd45_HG/prolif_subtypes.pdf", width = 12, height =6)
VlnPlot(DATA2, features = "S.Score", group.by = "Subtypes")
VlnPlot(DATA2,features = "S.Score", group.by = "Subtypes", split.by = "Condition")
VlnPlot(DATA2, features = "G2M.Score", group.by = "Subtypes")
VlnPlot(DATA2,features = "G2M.Score", group.by = "Subtypes", split.by = "Condition")
dev.off()

pdf(file = "results/Brain_Cd45_HG/prolif_subtypes_nodot.pdf", width = 12, height =6)
VlnPlot(DATA2, features = "S.Score", group.by = "Subtypes", pt.size = 0)
VlnPlot(DATA2,features = "S.Score", group.by = "Subtypes", split.by = "Condition", pt.size = 0)
VlnPlot(DATA2, features = "G2M.Score", group.by = "Subtypes", pt.size = 0)
VlnPlot(DATA2,features = "G2M.Score", group.by = "Subtypes", split.by = "Condition", pt.size = 0)
dev.off()
```
